reasoning_trace: Second independent injection of this fault type (round 2 of repeat sampling). Read the witness monitor output first, blind: settlement DOWN, then RECOVERED. Traced 11 payments spanning the window. All 11 show the same pattern already established for this fault type: gateway PAYMENT_SUBMITTED, audit, validation-enrichment PAYMENT_VALIDATED (or a normal business PAYMENT_REJECTED for two payments -- 2305a3b0 and 51ad8a19 -- not a stall), aml-compliance AML_SCREENING_COMPLETE, routing-execution RAIL_SELECTED and PAYMENT_ROUTED, fraud-scoring FRAUD_SCORE_COMPUTED -- and then nothing further. None show SETTLEMENT_COMPLETE. Consistent, clean stall specific to settlement, replicating the same evidentiary shape as the first DB_TIMEOUT gold case (LIVE-cd1f76ee). Conclusion reached from evidence alone, before reading the injector's own log: settlement.
confirmation_basis: Blind conclusion (settlement) matches the injector's own ground-truth log exactly. Second independent replication of this fault type -- same evidentiary shape as the first case, reinforcing that this pattern is reliable, not a one-off.
